query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS detailer_locations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  employee_id_loc VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  job_id_loc VARCHAR(64),
  customer_id_loc VARCHAR(64),
  latitude_loc DOUBLE NOT NULL,
  longitude_loc DOUBLE NOT NULL,
  is_active_loc ENUM('yes','no') NOT NULL DEFAULT 'yes',
  updated_at_loc TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
);
